  "concordance_definition": "The study aimed to demonstrate that nonclinical cardiac NAMs can recapitulate known mechanisms of cardiotoxic drugs, including detection of vanoxerine-induced delayed repolarization and prediction of proarrhythmia potential, thereby predicting clinical outcomes.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "hiPSC-CMs used represent 'healthy' backgrounds, not diseased states like AF.",
    "The two NAMs were not evaluated in parallel under identical experimental conditions.",
    "Acute (35 min per concentration) vanoxerine exposure was evaluated; chronic timepoints were out of scope.",
    "Nonspecific binding of compounds to materials can disrupt actual drug concentrations and data interpretation.",
    "Impact of complex cardiac MPS experimental configuration and conditions on vanoxerine-induced response cannot be excluded.",
    "hiPSC-CM MEA platforms typically do not provide flow or removal of metabolic waste products."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": "Work for the manuscript was completed by A.J.S.R. and K.D. while being employees of the FDA. A.J.S.R. is currently employed by Hovione PharmaScience Ltd. K.D. is currently employed by United Therapeutics Corporation. K.E.H., V.C., and B.A.S. have either a financial or equity relationship with Organos Inc., and both they and the company may benefit from commercialization of the results of this research. All other authors declare that they have no competing financial interests and that the article reflects the views of the authors and should not be construed to represent the FDA’s views or policies.",
  "key_numbers": [
    "Vanoxerine: 10 nM hERG block (30% at 3 Hz)",
    "Vanoxerine: 300 nM Cav1.2 block (83% at 1 Hz)",
    "Vanoxerine: 300 nM hNav1.5 block (66% at 3 Hz)",
    "Vanoxerine: 99% drug loss in complex cardiac MPS due to nonspecific binding.",
    "Vanoxerine: Cmax of 831 nM in complex cardiac MPS.",
    "Vanoxerine: Clinically relevant concentrations (Cmax of 8.3 nM and peak Cmax of 831 nM) associated with increased TdP risk.",
    "Sotalol: Negligible drug loss in complex cardiac MPS.",
    "Sotalol: Therapeutic Cmax of 2.7 µM.",
    "Vanoxerine: EAD-like events detected as early as 1 nM in hiPSC-CM MEA model at 1.5 Hz.",
    "Vanoxerine: EAD-like events detected as early as 10 nM in complex cardiac MPS under spontaneous conditions."
  ]
